mechanism: Additive nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity through independent mechanisms; aminoglycosides are nephrotoxic and ototoxic, while beta-lactams may potentiate aminoglycoside accumulation in renal tubules.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and audiometric function closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider tobramycin therapeutic drug monitoring and dose adjustment based on renal function.
